flags_and_gaps.note: No publicly available legal opinions from external counsel on token classification, Reg D/Reg S compliance, or securities status. Ondo references consultation with legal specialists but has not published opinions.

No specific insurance policy disclosed covering Ondo's tokenized products, smart contract risk, or operational errors. Custodian-level (SIPC) and government-level (FDIC for bank deposits) protections exist at the infrastructure layer.
Ondo references annual financial audits by independent audit firms but specific audit reports are not publicly linked. Monthly Ankura reconciliation reports provide ongoing verification.

OUSG's GP (Ondo I GP LLC) and investment manager (Ondo Capital Management LLC) are wholly owned subsidiaries of Ondo Finance Inc., creating affiliate dependency not present in the more structurally independent USDY and Global Markets SPVs.

Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited is incorporated in the British Virgin Islands with Swiss-law governing documents. Enforcement of tokenholder rights may face jurisdictional complexity compared to US-domiciled structures.
